issuer: the Ufficio Registro Automezzi e Trasporti
note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Consiglio Grande e Generale's own archive of laws, decrees and regulations. Decreto Delegato 22 August 2013 n.119 (amending Law 30 November 1995 n.134, the rules on issuing driving licences): the minimum age for category B is 18; Art. 12 as replaced: category A and B licences expire at the holder's 30th, 40th, 50th, 60th, 65th and 70th birthdays and then every three years, so a licence's term depends on the age it is taken at (twelve years for one taken at 18) and isn't held as a number of years. Decreto Delegato 30 July 2024 n.100 (the laser-engraved licence, issued from 4 November 2024 or when stocks run out): issue, renewal and the other formalities are subject to the charges of its Annex B, collected by the Ufficio Registro Automezzi e Trasporti; licences are issued to Sammarinese citizens and to foreigners resident in the Republic; Annex B charges the issue or confirmation of a licence by the validity it carries (up to 1 year €7, 3 €15, 5 €26, 10 €40, over 10 years €55) plus €30 for the document (the category B examination application €31 and €10 stamp duty not held). Because the charge turns on a validity that depends on the holder's age, no single fee is held (null). The 2013 decree recites the 2005 agreement with Italy on the reciprocal conversion of non-provisional licences; it doesn't say whether a test is set, so no exchange list is held. No identity card is the Ufficio's.
